user.title: Set up RFID Access Control
user.description: Enter the keypad ID and its Zigbee2MQTT topic. You can add more from the operator menu of the card.

error.no_device_id: Enter an ID for the keypad
error.no_mqtt_topic: Enter the MQTT topic of the keypad
error.invalid_mqtt_topic: The MQTT topic must contain at least one slash (e.g. zigbee2mqtt/name)

init.title: Keypad settings
init.description: MQTT topic and cover delay. The keypad reloads after saving.

data_description.tamper_delay: The keypad locks only if the cover stays open longer than this delay. The opening is always logged.

error.no_mqtt_topic: Enter the MQTT topic of the keypad
error.invalid_mqtt_topic: The MQTT topic must contain at least one slash (e.g. zigbee2mqtt/name)

add_user.name: Add user
add_user.description: Adds a user to the keypad, with PIN or card and optional temporary access.

remove_user.name: Remove user
remove_user.description: Removes a user from the keypad.

update_user.name: Update user
update_user.description: Updates name, PIN, card or access of a user. Empty PIN or card keeps the current value.

add_action.name: Add action
add_action.description: Adds an action that runs when the user enters, for the chosen keypad button.

remove_action.name: Remove action
remove_action.description: Removes an action from a user.

validate_access.name: Validate access
validate_access.description: Checks a PIN or card and runs the user's actions.

list_users.name: List users
list_users.description: Lists the users of the keypad.

set_admin_pin.name: Set admin PIN
set_admin_pin.description: Sets or changes the admin PIN. If already set, the current PIN is required.

set_operator_pin.name: Set operator PIN
set_operator_pin.description: Sets or changes the operator PIN. If already set, the current PIN is required.

clear_tamper_lock.name: Unlock after cover
clear_tamper_lock.description: Unlocks the keypad after the cover was opened, with the operator PIN.

verify_admin_pin.name: Verify admin PIN
verify_admin_pin.description: Checks the admin PIN. Returns valid, locked_out and not_set.

test_access_code.name: Test an access code
test_access_code.description: Says whose code it is, without running actions (needs the operator PIN).

set_installer_mode.name: Installer mode
set_installer_mode.description: Turns installer mode on for 0-60 minutes, or off (needs the operator PIN).

get_user_pin.name: Read user PIN
get_user_pin.description: Returns a user's PIN. Needs the admin PIN; wrong tries count toward the lockout.

add_sos_action.name: Add SOS action
add_sos_action.description: Adds a global action that runs on the SOS key.

copy_user.name: Copy user
copy_user.description: Copies a user to another keypad. Needs the admin PIN of the target keypad.

discover_keypads.name: Discover keypads
discover_keypads.description: Reads the keypads available in Zigbee2MQTT.
